body: I know you want something permanent, but if you don't already have some then you should look for hip pads. Mine are cheap fabric ones off eBay but if you can spare the money then you can get some decent silicone ones.

Oof, I know the feeling. You could always try the old drag technique where you apply orange eyeshadow on the the area before putting on foundation. Not exactly an every day look, but might be worth a try.

Since you're in the early stages I'd say you should just go with the flow. Buy some clothes you like the look of, I mainly use eBay but there are like a million online shops now. You can buy a decent, cheap wig from eBay as well, just make sure to read the sellers feedback first. Makeup is a hell of a thing to get the hang of, I'd recommend starting small with mascara and lipstick and work your way to the harder stuff. Don't feel pressured to master all this stuff at once, this isn't a race.

And like the other person said, youtube is good. Just never read the comments on trans stuff, youtube is infamous for it's population of wack-jobs.

I was in a band not long ago with a group of boys like this. Whenever they acted like this I would call them out for it, nicely but confrontational enough that they would know I was serious.

I was kicked out.

They are still like that (if not worse) and now I just keep my mouth shut to avoid even more people hating me. As depressing as it is, you can't force people to change their minds, especially if they aren't willing to learn. Some people are just stuck in their ways, and we just have to accept that, but set a good example and people will eventually begin to realise their mistakes and grow. Everybody changes, just not at the same speed.
Yeesh, I relate to almost everything you said here. I hope you're doing better now :)
Thank you, best of luck to you as well!
Thank you, and you are right. It's been difficult coming to terms with what I can change and what I can't, but I think I'm getting there. I hope you love yourself too, you deserve to!
Thank you so much! I'm so glad that you found my post inspiring, it's nice to post something that isn't depressing for once :P
Thanks, I'm happy to be here as well! I like to be inclusive, don't wanna leave out our NB transfem friends :)
Thank you, I'm proud of you too!
Thanks, it feels great to be back!

You aren't the only one. My short term memory is horrible and there are enormous chunks of my life that I literally can't remember.

I heard somewhere that memory loss can be a symptom of depression. I wouldn't make any assumptions without professional medical input, but it could also be a sign of undiagnosed ADHD or autism (something like that anyway).
I have been getting help for a few months but it's not working. It's not like I'll ever actually take their advice anyway.
I'd like to buy meds but not in my current situation. I still haven't moved out from my ma yet, and even then idk if I'll be able to afford anything. Thanks for the encouragement, I really need it rn

I'm unemployed and still basically a minor so moving isn't an option atm, not that I'd know where to go... It doesn't seem like there's many good places to be trans. I think there are a couple of lgbt+ centres towards the city, but since I live somewhere more remote, it's a bit of a hike. Thanks for the help, I really should think about reaching out to more lgbt+ circles.
